name: StoreEngine – Powerful WordPress eCommerce Plugin for Payments, Memberships, Affiliates, Sales & More
author: Kodezen Limited

sections.description:
The WordPress eCommerce Plugin for Small Business Success

👉 StoreEngine Site
👉 Documentation of StoreEngine
👉 StoreEngine Pro
👉 Public Roadmap
👉 [StoreEngine + Academy LMS] = 🔥

StoreEngine is a powerful WordPress eCommerce plugin designed to help you create and manage any type of online store with ease. Whether you’re selling physical products, digital downloads, or memberships, StoreEngine provides advanced features like flexible payment options, affiliate systems, and seamless integrations. Build a fast, scalable, and user-friendly eCommerce website tailored to your needs with StoreEngine.

Check our overview video of StoreEngine 👇

🤝 Join the thriving StoreEngine community today!

Dive into a thriving network of eCommerce entrepreneurs, course creators, developers, and online business experts by integrating StoreEngine with your platform. Be a part of our mission to empower seamless, scalable, and secure online selling experiences worldwide.

Stay connected for the latest updates and insights:

👉 Join our Facebook Group
👉 Follow us on Twitter
👉 Connect in our Linkedin
👉 Our Official Support
👉 Video Tutorials

Features

Payment Flexibility

StoreEngine provides diverse payment options to suit any business model:

One-Time Payments: Perfect for selling single items or standalone products.
Subscription Payments: Build recurring revenue streams by offering subscription plans for products or services (upcoming).
Installment Payments: Enable customers to pay for high-value products in manageable installments, making them more accessible.
Offline Payments: Offer cash on delivery (COD) for customers who prefer traditional payment methods.
PayPal & Stripe Integration: Accept global payments using trusted gateways to ensure secure and hassle-free transactions.

Affiliate System

Drive traffic and grow your sales with the built-in affiliate system:

Affiliate Dashboard: Partners can monitor their earnings, referral links, and performance from a user-friendly dashboard.
Customizable Commission Rates: Set specific rates for affiliates to incentivize top performers.
Automated Payouts: Streamline affiliate payouts with minimal effort.

Membership Management

Turn your store into a thriving community with robust membership tools:

Tiered Membership Plans: Create multiple membership levels with unique perks and pricing.
Recurring Payments: Ensure consistent income with automated subscription renewals (upcoming).
Access Controls: Restrict content, products, or discounts based on membership tiers.

Coupon Management

Boost customer engagement and sales with dynamic discount campaigns:

Percentage or Fixed Discounts: Offer flexible discount types based on your promotion strategy.
Expiration Dates: Create time-limited campaigns to create urgency.
Usage Restrictions: Set conditions for coupon usage, such as minimum purchase amount or applicable product categories.

Digital Software Licenses (upcoming)

Efficiently sell and manage digital products with licensing features:

License Key Generation: Automatically generate license keys upon purchase.
Activation Limits: Restrict licenses to a certain number of activations.
Renewals & Upgrades: Allow customers to renew or upgrade their licenses seamlessly.

Optimized for Speed

Keep your store fast and efficient with lightweight architecture:

Blazing-Fast Load Times: Reduce cart abandonment rates with a quick-loading store.
Efficient Codebase: Built using best practices for optimized performance.
Seamless Updates: Regular plugin updates ensure compatibility with the latest WordPress version.

Seamless Admin Interface

Manage your store effortlessly with an intuitive Single Page Application (SPA) dashboard:

Product Management: Add, edit, and categorize products quickly.
Order Tracking: Monitor order status and manage customer queries with ease.
Analytics Overview: Access key insights like revenue, sales trends, and top-performing products.

Enhanced User Experience

Deliver an engaging shopping experience that keeps customers coming back:

Customer Dashboards: Users can track their orders, payments, and download purchases from a dedicated dashboard.
Customizable Storefronts: Tailor your store’s design with templates or custom layouts.
Mobile Optimization: Ensure a flawless shopping experience across all devices.

Email Notification System

Keep everyone in the loop with automated emails for every transaction:

Customer Notifications: Send order confirmations, shipping updates, and payment receipts.
Admin Alerts: Get notified about new orders, stock levels, and other critical updates.
Customizable Email Templates: Match emails to your brand’s style and tone.

Academy LMS Integration

Monetize your online courses effortlessly with StoreEngine:

Sell Courses: Seamlessly list and sell courses alongside other products.
Membership Access: Offer exclusive memberships for course content.
LMS Support: Expand functionality with integrations for third-party LMS plugins.

Customizability & Scalability

StoreEngine adapts effortlessly to meet the unique demands of your business, whether you’re just starting or running a
large-scale enterprise. With its limitless customization options, you can create a store that perfectly reflects your
brand identity. Choose from pre-built templates for a quick setup or design a completely unique storefront from scratch
to stand out in the competitive eCommerce landscape.

As your business evolves, StoreEngine grows with you, offering scalable solutions to accommodate increasing demands.
Extend your store’s capabilities with premium addons, adding advanced functionalities tailored to your needs. Whether
you’re managing a small boutique or a global marketplace, StoreEngine ensures your store remains flexible, efficient,
and ready for success at every stage of your journey.
sections.faq:
What payment options are supported?

StoreEngine supports one-time, subscription, and installment payments. Integrate with PayPal, Stripe, or offer offline
options like cash on delivery (COD).

Can I manage coupons and affiliates?

Yes! StoreEngine includes a built-in coupon management tools and affiliate system (upcoming).

Will StoreEngine slow down my website?

Not at all! StoreEngine is lightweight and optimized for speed, ensuring minimal impact on performance.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0-beta-2 – 09/04/2025

  • Improvement: Added order placed date (as metadata), separate from order created date.
  • Improvement: Permalink settings added for customizing product permalink structure.
  • Fixed: Order status while user purchase as guest.
  • Fixed: Order created in update query.
  • Fixed: Order date on thank-you page.
  • Fixed: Admin product editor ui.
  • Fixed: Deprecation error on product archive page if max_page_num is 1
  • Fixed: Typo in admin dashboard
  • Fixed: Textdomain mismatched.
  • Fixed: Invalid order date in admin dashboard.
  • Fixed: Fatal error on single product page if both WooCommerce & StoreEngine is active sametime.
  • Fixed: Tax settings page in admin dashboard.
  • Fixed: Mics. spacing & text color fixed.

1.0.0-beta-1 – 07/04/2025

  • Initial Release
    • Academy LMS native integration,
    • Multi price model for product,
    • Multiple payment method:
    • PayPal,
    • Stripe,
    • Cash On Delivery,
    • Direct Bank Transfer,
    • Check Payment, etc.
    • Payment listing,
    • Full/Partial refunds,
    • Email Notification,
    • Tax,
    • Coupon,
    • Simple & Variable product,
    • Downloadable product,
    • Image gallery for product,
    • Variable product price adjustments,
    • Affiliate,
    • Membership,
    • Webhook,
    • ShortCodes, etc.
